podcast.title: Final LP with Fleetwood Mac - Bare Trees (1972)
podcast.body: *Bare Trees* (1972) was Danny Kirwan's final LP with Fleetwood Mac, featuring his guitar musings. He was fired later that year after a violent nervous breakdown, leading to Bob Welch and Christine McVie taking over primary songwriting duties. "Danny Kerwin in his final LP with the group."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Fired from Fleetwood Mac - Violent Nervous Breakdown (1972)
podcast.body: After experiencing a violent nervous breakdown in the summer of 1972, Danny Kirwan was fired from Fleetwood Mac. This event led to Bob Welch and Christine McVie assuming primary songwriting duties for the band. "After a violent nervous breakdown in the summer of 72, Danny Kerwin was fired."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia

podcast.title: Teenage Prodigy - Replacing Peter Green
podcast.body: Danny Kirwan was a "teenage prodigy" recruited into Fleetwood Mac after Peter Green departed. His playing was described as even "tripier and more eclectic" than Green's, indicating a shift in the band's guitar sound. "Danny Kerwin, a teenage prodigy whose playing was even tripier and more eclectic than green."

srcs.source: Hit Parade Music History and Music Trivia
